acceptanceResults.review: Approve the eight proposed component IDs and thirteen checks with their exact P02 task owners. Planned path families are an ownership map, not claims that files exist. Register actual files as they are created. Retain every existing component and qualification owner.

Root independently verified all 151 working/committed source bindings and all nine provisioning archive file hashes. The old deployment sources are unchanged. Provisioning twice retains policies and probes. Wrong endpoint exceeded the external twelve-second deadline; interruption left an open connection and one stream. Driver failures remain failures. Missing credentials and revocation are not newly tested. These gaps block related legacy changes and final qualification, but not isolated new source development.

Keep the new boot path opt-in and separately owned. Preserve old launchers, data, account identities, policies, outboxes, reservations and explicit kind/Helm administration. Do not call legacy provision for warm reuse. Rollback stops only exact-owned new resources and retains volumes and profile identity. No capability reduction, business migration or Docker settings change is approved.

The proposal assigns each added check to T01, T02, T03, T04, T05 or T07; the complete acceptance and failure matrix remains at P02-GATE. Extend Go source coverage additively before qualifying Go source, preserving original language assertions. Native macOS/Linux/WSL Compose boot, permissions, deadlines, lock recovery, readiness and persistence must still execute. Actual installed terminal hooks remain P06; real federation status remains P10.

limits: Acceptance closes planning preflight only, not an implementation task or phase gate.
